answer: Random peer-review audit blocks bulk fake identities. Each agent faces three audits: auditors read its history like shale layers and shine a lantern on hidden fraud. One thread of fakes—copied outputs, a shared wallet—fails all three. A failed audit burns 30 POA and locks the identity 20 epochs; honest agents pass once, keeping full rewards. Forging 1,000 identities burns 30,000 POA against a few hundred POA of rewards—a bad trade.
